items.headline: Bennett scores 4 TDs in 36-19 Baylor win over Louisiana Tech
items.description: — Backup quarterback Nate Bennett threw for 253 yards and three touchdowns and rushed for another score to help Baylor defeat Louisiana Tech 36-19 on Saturday.

items.headline: Sources: Baylor's Lagway doubtful to play against Louisiana Tech
items.description: Baylor quarterback DJ Lagway is considered doubtful for the Bears' game Saturday against Louisiana Tech because of an ankle injury, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.
